note: Adapted from the 'Diagnostic Character' and the measurements of Table 5 in Mukherjee et al., 'Termite (Isoptera) fauna of the Himalaya including its zoogeographical analysis' (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India, archive.org identifier dli.zoological.memoirs.021.02); the original is in English. The account is a concise diagnostic description rather than a full morphological description, and there is no measurement table for the alate. The original notes that the detailed synonymy is given in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera, 1: 253—256. From line 311 of the source package onwards the text belongs to the next species, Neotermes microculatus, and was not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: head suboval, slightly wider than long, the sides narrowing posteriorly, Y-shaped suture distinct; ocelli large, translucent, suboval, almost touching the eye patch; antennae 18—19-segmented, segment 2 far longer than segment 3, segment 3 longer than segment 4; pronotum subrectangular, wider than the head capsule including the eyes, anterior margin broadly concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Soldier: head subsquare with a rounded posterior margin; antennae 14—16-segmented (segment 3 about as long as segment 2, segment 4 shortest); mandibles stout, longer than half the head length to the base of the mandibles; left mandible with 3—5 marginal teeth increasing in size, right mandible with 2 large triangular marginal teeth; anterior margin of the pronotum broadly concave, without a distinct median notch.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and postclypeus pale brown to dark brown, labrum and pronotum brown. Head and pronotum sparsely hairy. Head suboval, slightly wider than long, the sides narrowing posteriorly; Y-shaped suture distinct. Ocelli translucent, large, oval, almost touching the eye patch. Antennae 18—19-segmented, segment 2 far longer than segment 3, segment 3 longer than segment 4. Clypeus trapezoidal. Labrum ligulate, hairy. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum subrectangular, wider than the width of the head capsule including the eyes; anterior margin broadly concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Venation broadly as in the genus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown to dark brown, body almost white. Head subrectangular, posterior margin rounded. Antennae 14—16-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Labrum far wider than long, the anterior margin slightly convex, with several hairs at the apex and on the disc. Mandibles stout, longer than half the head length to the base of the mandibles; left mandible with 3—5 marginal teeth increasing in size, right mandible with 2 large triangular marginal teeth. Postmentum clavate, bilobed anteriorly. Pronotum subrectangular, sparsely hairy, anterior margin broadly concave, without a distinct median notch, posterior margin nearly straight. Measurements (mm, paratype/known range): head length to the base of the mandibles 3.60/3.60—4.50; maximum head width 2.55/2.60—2.88; maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.30/0.30—0.42; head index (width/length) 0.71; maximum labrum length 0.35/0.36—0.42, maximum width 0.58/0.60—0.78; left mandible length 1.96/2.00—2.76; mandible–head length index (left mandible length/head length) 0.54/0.50—0.65; minimum median length of the postmentum 2.76—3.36; maximum width of the postmentum 0.90—1.02, waist width 0.30—0.43; maximum pronotum length 1.48/1.10—1.62, maximum width 2.46—3.00; number of antennal segments 16/14—16.
